# nrvna

> Durable local AI work, built from three commands.

`wrk` publishes one independent job. `nrvnad` runs one model against one
workspace: `nrvnad <workspace> <model>`. `flw` reads status and results.
Agents and apps can use or compose the same commands. Context does not
continue between jobs. `--parent` records lineage only.

Use the installed `--help` output for command syntax. The authoritative
filesystem and lifecycle contracts are `include/nrvna/contract.hpp` and
`include/nrvna/lifecycle.hpp`.
